fields.label: Address
fields.help: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the endpoint.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Endpoint ID
fields.help: The Resource ID must be 1-63 characters long, including digits, lowercase letters or the hyphen character.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The URL to the network, such as projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/networks/NETWORK_NAME.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: Port that the endpoint is running on, must be in the range of [0, 65535].

fields.label: Service
fields.help: The resource name of the service that this endpoint provides.
